Net asset value at end of period | $ | 20.37

findings.detail: Source reports 2025 income_yield_pct as 11.05%, so F16 threshold is 16.575% and the observed distribution_rate of 11.4343% should not fail.

rationale: The filing's financial highlights report net investment income to average net assets of 11.05% for 2025. The same table reports total dividends declared of 2.32 and ending NAV of 20.37, consistent with an approximately 11.4% distribution rate. Because 11.4343% is below 1.5 times the source income yield (16.575%), the F16 failure indicates the extracted income-yield metric or its scale is wrong rather than a genuine excessive distribution.
